title: Frequency-band Mirror Views over shared S4 kernel
hypothesis: A shared stable diagonal S4 kernel plus two-coordinate role codes that shift pole timescales recovers four band-specific sequence filters at <=60% independent-kernel actual bytes and <=1.10x NRMSE.
physical_object: shared diagonal S4 pole spectrum and input/output coefficients
mirror_coordinate: two per-role coefficients shifting log decay rates along fixed slow/fast spectral directions

task.teacher: one shared stable eight-pole S4D kernel with role-specific two-coordinate shifts that generate slow/mid/fast/broadband filters

success_gate: Every fresh world at length 128: Mirror NRMSE <=1.10x independent, actual bytes <=60% independent, stable poles, MAC proxy <=1.25x independent.
failure_gate: Any quality/byte/stability/compute gate fails, or equal-rank pole residual matches Mirror quality at lower bytes.
boundaries: No FFT implementation or language model claim.
CPU proxy costs do not establish accelerator throughput.
